title: Invite members
acceptance:
Story: the admin invites a person without handing over admin rights.
Expected: POST /invitations as admin mints a one-time invitation; POST /accounts with that invitation creates a member account, a private home and a one-time key in the response; a used invitation cannot be reused.
Not expected: email delivery, invitation expiry or members inviting members.
Depends on: WI-12 first-run admin and WI-13 sessions.
Verify: acceptance invites, creates a member, and confirms the invitation is spent.
evidence: Admin invitation then POST /accounts creates a member home and one-time key; a used invitation answers 403 and the claim is atomic inside the transaction, so concurrent reuse cannot create a second account. PR #6: https://github.com/chakibelbassam/FoundationOS/pull/6.
